sentences.text: Shriram General Insurance Company Limited Versus Smt. Devki Sahu
14.12.2023 Shri P.R.Patankar, counsel for the appellant.

Heard on I.A.No.02/2023, which is an application for condonation o
 delay in filing the appeal.
On due consideration and for the reasons assigned therein, the sam  allowed and the delay of 03 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
Issue notice to the respondents, on payment of P.F. as per rules.
Also heard on I.A.No.01/2023, an application for grant of stay.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the claim petition has been filed by the claimants under Section 163-A of the Motor Vehicles Act, whereas as per amendment in Motor Vehicles Act, the compensation payable to the claimants was fixed upto Rs.5,00,000/-., but the learned Claims Tribunal has erred in awarding Rs.13,44,880/- as compensation, which is more than Rs.5,00,000/-.
Having considered the submissions of the counsel for the appellant, I.A.No.01/2023 is allowed.

Purely as an interim measure, it is directed that on depositing a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- of the awarded amount by the appellant/insurance company within a period of 45 days from today before the concerned Claims Tribunal, the execution of recovery of remaining awarded amount shall remain stayed till further orders.
It is further directed that the said amount shall be disbursed to the claimants/respondents No.1 & 2, as per the terms and conditions of the award.
In view of above, I.A.Nos.01 & 02 of 2023 stand disposed of.
List the matter after service is complete.

Sd/-
(Radhakishan Agrawal) Judge Anjani Shriram General Insurance Company ... vs Smt. Devki Sahu on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153915091/
